project_type: Go backend + Angular v22 frontend, full-stack vulnerability intelligence tool
build_system: Makefile-based. Key targets: make build-no-ui (Go only), make test (Go tests), make lint (golangci-lint), make ui-build (Angular pnpm build), make ui-test (Vitest), make ui-i18n-extract (extract i18n strings)
test_framework: Go: standard testing package with table-driven tests, net/http/httptest for API tests, testcontainers-go for integration tests. Frontend: Vitest via pnpm run test
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'go build ./...' to confirm compilation. 2. Run 'go test ./internal/server/ ./internal/store/ -v -count=1' for Go unit tests. 3. For UI: 'cd ui && pnpm install && pnpm run test -- --watch=false' (Vitest). 4. Run 'go vet ./...' for static analysis.
snapshot_or_generated_files: ui/src/locale/messages.xlf is generated by 'make ui-i18n-extract'. ui/src/locale/messages.ja.xlf is manually maintained. No other generated/snapshot files.
setup_instructions: Go 1.26.5 available via asdf (.tool-versions). pnpm 10.28.1, Node 22.23.1 available. No Docker daemon needed for unit tests.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode - full access. No Docker daemon available for container-based tests. PostgreSQL not running - integration tests skipped. Use unit tests only.
contribution_requirements: Follow Go standard conventions (MixedCaps naming, doc comments on exports). Migration naming: {number}_{description}.up.sql / .down.sql. Angular i18n: custom IDs @@component.purpose, source locale English, translations Japanese. Use pnpm exec not npx. After adding UI text, run make ui-i18n-extract.
key_patterns: Store interface in internal/store/store.go - all new DB methods must be added here. mockStore in internal/server/server_test.go must implement new interface methods. Server routes in internal/server/server.go routes() method. API handlers in separate files (dashboard.go, stats.go). Database queries in internal/store/ (epss.go, lev.go, dashboard.go, stats_trend.go). UI services in ui/src/app/services/. Chart.js used for all graphs (chart.js v4.5.1). Existing EpssChartComponent in ui/src/app/shared/epss-chart/ as pattern. Angular standalone components with signals.
directory_structure: cmd/ - CLI entrypoint. internal/server/ - HTTP handlers (go-chi router). internal/store/ - PostgreSQL persistence (database/sql + pgx stdlib). internal/model/ - Data models. internal/webhook/ - Webhook dispatch engine. ui/src/app/pages/ - Angular page components. ui/src/app/services/ - Angular HTTP services. ui/src/app/shared/ - Reusable components (epss-chart, pagination, etc.). migrations/ - SQL migration files (currently 000001-000032).
